title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON SECURITY OVER MOVABLE PROPERTY, CLAIMS, ETC.
title_original: 동산ㆍ채권 등의 담보에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON SECURITY OVER MOVABLE PROPERTY, CLAIMS, ETC.

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Security over Movable Property, Claims, etc. and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Securities Excluded from the Objects of Security Rights over Movable Property)
The term "securities prescribed by Presidential Decree, including bearer bond certificates" in Article 3 (3) 3 of the Act on Security over Movable Property, Claims, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means the following:
1. Bearer bond certificates;
2. Asset-backed securities under subparagraph 4 of Article 2 of the Asset-Backed Securitization Act;
3. Securities under Article 4 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act.

Article 3 (Notice of Direct Appropriation of Collateral, etc.)
(1) Where, when giving notice under Article 23 (1) and (2) of the Act, the secured creditor considers that there will be no amount remaining after deduction of the amount of the secured claim from the appraised value or estimated sale proceeds of the collateral, the secured creditor shall state that fact.
(2) Where, when giving notice under Article 23 (1) and (2) of the Act, there are several items of collateral, the secured creditor shall state the claim and costs intended to be extinguished in proportion to the appraised value or estimated sale proceeds of each item of collateral.
(3) Notice under Article 23 (1) and (2) of the Act may be given by mail or any other appropriate means.
(4) Notice under Article 23 (1) and (2) of the Act to an interested person registered in the security register as a right holder in relation to the collateral may be given to that person's address recorded in the register.
(5) Where a secured creditor, without negligence, is unable to ascertain the whereabouts of the debtor, etc. and interested persons known to the secured creditor and therefore cannot give notice by a method under paragraph (3), the secured creditor may give notice in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Procedure Act governing service by public notice.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 22457, Oct. 21, 2010>

This Decree shall enter into force on June 11, 2012.
